_comment: Table 8 telemetry rows grouped by demo scenario. Used by tests and data_loader.

fi_hitl_test._comment: No broadband (vib_rms=2.2 < baseline*1.3=2.47), all bands below stage-1, kurtosis=4.5 drives T2 anomaly but no rule matches -> undetermined -> confidence<0.60 -> Gate 3 fires

knowledge_hitl_test._comment: Lubrication fingerprint: vib_rms=2.9 (ratio=1.38>1.3), kurtosis=4.0 < ceiling(5.0), broadband pattern, temp_rise=6C. Lubrication_issue matches at stage1, confidence>0.60 -> Gate3 skipped. Knowledge finds no SOP (lubrication_issue not in catalog, score<0.45) -> Gate5 fires

cage_fault._comment: Cage fault FT_006 stage_1: ftf=1.5>=1.3 and FTF is dominant (1.5>bsf=1.1>bpfo=0.9>bpfi=0.7). Kurtosis=5.1>=4.5. vib=3.0 < baseline(2.6)*1.3=3.38 so broadband is NOT triggered. FT_001 blocked (bpfo=0.9<1.5). Asset: AST_GBX_001/BRG_012(OUTPUT)/CH_012.
Cage fault FT_006 stage_2: ftf=2.2>=2.0 and dominant (2.2>bsf=1.6>bpfo=1.1>bpfi=0.9). Kurtosis=5.8>=4.5. vib=3.1 still below broadband threshold (3.38).

Cage fault FT_006 stage_3 (critical): ftf=3.8>=3.5 and dominant (3.8>bsf=2.0>bpfo=1.3>bpfi=1.1). Kurtosis=6.8>=4.5. vib=3.8>=3.38 so broadband detection is also True here, but FT_006 (priority=3) wins over FT_003 (priority=4) — lubrication appears only as differential. FT_001 blocked (bpfo=1.3<1.5).

electrical_anomaly._comment: Electrical anomaly: current_deviation=1.8 (high — electrical fault pattern). All four T² features (vib=1.7, kurtosis=2.2, temp=51.5, bpfo=0.5) are at/near their BRG_004 baselines so T² << threshold and A2 emits NO AnomalyEvent. A3 never runs. Validates system does not misclassify elevated motor current as a bearing frequency fault. Asset: AST_MTR_002/BRG_004(NDE)/CH_004.

thermal_event._comment: Pure thermal event: temp_c=92 (rise=33C above BRG_006 baseline 59C). Bearing vibration is healthy: vib_rms=2.1, ratio=2.1/2.3=0.91<1.3 so broadband NOT triggered, no defect band energy above stage-1. T² fires from extreme temp z-score (~16.5) so A2 emits AnomalyEvent. A3 returns undetermined — no bearing frequency fault rule matches. Tests graceful handling of thermal anomaly that is not a bearing defect. Asset: AST_PMP_001/BRG_006(NDE)/CH_006.

borderline_fault._comment: Borderline stage-1: bpfo=1.3 (below FT_001 stage_1_multiple=1.5) AND kurtosis=4.8 (below FT_001 kurtosis_threshold=5.0). Both thresholds NOT crossed so FT_001 does not fire. vib_rms=2.4, ratio=2.4/2.1=1.14<1.3 so broadband NOT triggered and FT_003 does not fire. T² fires from elevated kurtosis z=8.0 and bpfo z=7.0, so A2 emits AnomalyEvent. A3 returns undetermined. Tests the detection boundary — anomaly is detectable but not yet classifiable. Asset: AST_PMP_002/BRG_007(DE)/CH_007.

load_spike._comment: Load spike transient: load_pct=95 (high but within DFA max_load_pct=110). startup_shutdown_flag=false, rpm=1472 at rated 1475. All bearing vibration signals are near baseline — DFA returns VALID, T² remains low (no anomaly). Validates that DFA does not reject high-load-but-healthy data, and A2 does not false-positive under load stress alone. Asset: AST_PMP_002/BRG_008(NDE)/CH_008.
